name: Talara
description: An elvish safewright who protects a woodland waterfall and prefers the screams of battle to the quiet after.

description_citations.text: Eventide: card flavor text (Eventide, 2008), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Talara vows to send wave after wave of warriors against any who disturb a waterfall.
timeline.quote: She has vowed to send wave after wave of warriors to slay any who would dare disturb its beauty.

citation.text: Talara's Battalion (Eventide, 2008), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.
